operations.before: "Use the same bounded child stdout. Monitor uses exactly '# C2FT3 ' plus canonical JSON keys id,value and LF; scope uses '# C2FT4 ' plus keys id,value,w,s,h and LF, one row per corresponding label. Each frame and LF is <=96 ASCII bytes. value is a string 0, 1, 2+ or UNKNOWN; w,s,h obey getWinner rules. Keep native/TAP/Source/journal joins and stream-taint rules. Original scope C2FT3 is incompatible; no raw frame or child stdout enters the public artifact."
operations.after: "Use the same bounded child stdout. The current producer emits monitor as '# C2FT3 ' plus canonical JSON keys id,value and LF, and scope as '# C2FT4 ' plus keys id,value,w,s,h and LF. The publisher also accepts a canonical C2FT3 scope frame as count-only compatibility. A valid C2FT3 scope frame with a known bucket and the required ordered native/TAP/Source/journal joins may yield afterScopeMissing.reason JOINED_SNAPSHOT. It supplies no winner tuple, so getWinner remains UNKNOWN and an independently known HTTP observation is preserved. A canonical C2FT4 scope frame can supply the winner tuple subject to the existing eligibility, status and normalization checks. Each frame and LF is at most 96 ASCII bytes. Count value is a string 0, 1, 2+ or UNKNOWN. The existing stream framing, order, and duplicate rules apply across both formats, including two frames for the same scope ordinal. No raw frame or child stdout enters the public artifact."

offsetRule: Zero-based UTF-16 indices into full before and after strings, ascending. Match literal at its indexed position before substituting. Compute exact body digest after each direction.
